items.title: Welcome to WikiOrlando
items.text:
WikiOrlando exists to help new residents in the Orlando area who arent aware of the resources available to them. This resource focuses on making web content more accessible and easier to find.

Resources are available in both English and Spanish by hovering and clicking on the __ button at the top of the page.

items.title: Acknowledgement
items.text: I'd like to thank the Hispanic Office For Local Assistance for assisting in this project and for all the wonderful resources they have provided to residents in Orlando.

items.title: About
items.text:
Feedback & Contributing

  • If you discover outdated contact info, broken links, or would like to suggest resources that would benefit this collection, feel free to send them to the email: info@wikiorlando.org

items.title: Emergency essentials
items.text:
Life is an unpredictable journey filled with various challenges. If you're facing hardships, these resources bellow are here to help you during these difficult times. Here, you can find shelters, food aid, healthcare, and other essential resources. Remember, you're not alone and will come out stronger on the other side.

Important

  • If you're having an Emergency, please call 911
  • If you're experiencing emotional distress or mental health struggles, please call 988 for the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
  • For City of Orlando resources and support, call 211
  • For Orange County support, call 311
